about: Golden vectors for franchise channels and the FRANCHISES / OTHER COLLECTIONS split. Read by Nostalgex/NostalgexTests/FranchiseLineupGoldenTests.swift (the Apple TV), scripts/nostalgex-franchise-lineup-smoke.mjs (the web tuner and Docker, npm run test:franchise-lineup) and the Roku tests (a byte copy in roku/tests/vectors). The expected answers were written by the Swift test from the Apple TV's own code (see its regenerate switch), so no engine here marked its own work. Each lineup builds one library with the shared franchises.json and channels.json, applies the stated choices, and compares the Settings rows, the folds, the runtime channels and the guide.

lineups.name: a bit of everything, package on
lineups.about: Classics 100, 101 and 102 are in the lineup, 103-106 are not. John Wick and Spy Kids are switched on, Harry Potter is switched off, Star Trek starts on by the dictionary. The Mandalorian and Loki join their classics. Spider-Man's MCU films also pass MARVEL's studio rule and are counted once, on SPIDER-MAN. Eleven server collections: some fold into a classic or a found franchise, one mixed collection must not, two stay.

lineups.about: The union adds The Mandalorian, Ahsoka and Andor to CH 300 unless another channel owns the episode: m2 is manifest-exclusive to 150, a1 matches an exclusive rule for channel 150 by title, m3 is claimed by channel 140 under a manifestExclusive rule, a2 matches a genre lock. m1, m4 and n1 get in. A collection of the show folds by manifest overlap.

lineups.name: the franchise block is full
lineups.about: 94 found franchises are on (five with 3 films, the rest 4) and two franchise collections (5 and 3 films): 96 want 90 places, so the six 3-film ones wait whatever their kind. The kept ones are numbered A to Z, CH 310-399, and the other collection keeps CH 400.

lineups.name: franchise collections alone fill the block
lineups.about: 93 franchise collections are on, three with 3 films and the rest 5: the three wait, the 90 kept take CH 310-399 A to Z, and nothing spills into 400.

lineups.name: other collections over their block
lineups.about: 103 other collections are on and 100 fit: the first 100 A to Z take CH 400-499, three are not built.

lineups.name: names in Settings and numbers in the guide
lineups.about: Settings sorts case-insensitively with digit runs as numbers (FRANCHISE 2 before FRANCHISE 10); the guide numbers by code point (FRANCHISE 10 before FRANCHISE 2). Two different orders for the same list, on every platform.

lineups.name: defaults and the viewer's choices
lineups.about: Fast & Furious and Star Trek start on by the dictionary; The Matrix and The Hunger Games start off. The viewer switched Star Trek off and The Matrix on. Spy Kids has two films, under the gate of three, so it is not found at all. A choice is kept for a franchise whether or not the library has it.
